docs.n_games: Distinct game_id (race for F1). n_from_score_rows / n_from_backfill count ROWS.
docs.p_model_better: Share of bootstrap draws with the paired difference > 0.
docs.paired_logloss_diff: Mean over games of (market log-loss - model log-loss), each game averaging its rows; positive = model better. 95% percentile bootstrap over games, 2000 resamples, fixed seed.
docs.population: Settled, non-void rows with model_p and market_price. Score rows (one per game+market, no stake, earliest pre-kickoff observation) first; candidate and shadow rows are a backfill only for (game_id, market) pairs that have no score row, deduped by (game_id, market, ticker), earliest logged_at wins. Backfill rows were selected for a >= 4 point model-over-market edge, so they flatter the model: read n_from_backfill as an upper bound on model quality until score rows dominate.
